description: Count South Korean business days between two dates (both ends included by default). Also returns weekend and weekday-holiday counts. Holiday data covers 2024-2027 (source: KASI; updated 2026-11-12). It includes substitute holidays and election days, and the 2026 additions Labor Day (May 1) and Constitution Day (Jul 17).

extra_closed_dates.description: Optional extra non-working dates (YYYY-MM-DD), e.g. company holidays.

name: kr_count_business_days
title: Count Korean business days
